connector.name: Trading212 MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Trading 212 API - portfolio, orders, pies, dividends, and analytics
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package trading212-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kyurish account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TRADING212_API_KEY
env.description: Trading 212 API key from Settings > API (Beta)

env.name: TRADING212_API_SECRET
env.description: Trading 212 API secret from Settings > API (Beta)

env.name: ENVIRONMENT
env.description: API environment: 'live' for real account, 'demo' for paper trading
